messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: High error rate for tenant CardioLabs in dedicated-ap-southeast-pool-2. Detected at ~2026-03-20T02:00Z. Autoretry failing. Severity: P1. @here
Nora (oncall): I'm taking this. CardioLabs is enterprise VPC with strict isolation, no auto-hosted fallback. Hana, are they on standby pool?
Hana (Customer Success): They have a standby pool dedicated-ap-southeast-standby-1 but they asked us not to failover automatically without consent. Ops is on the line.
CardioLabsOps: We're seeing request timeouts and 5xx for inference endpoints. Some batch jobs stuck. Urgent — any risk of data loss?
Sree (SRE): Quick triage: pool nodes show `kv_checkpoint_mismatch` and `eviction_error` spikes. Disk IO on node-2c showing intermittent errors. Looks like metadata inconsistency in KV shards.
Nora (oncall): OK plan: 1) snapshot KV and logs 2) propose manual failover to standby (seek customer approval) 3) disable affected nodes 4) run repair. Hana to confirm with customer.
Sree (SRE): Snapshot command run:```kvtool dump --tenant CardioLabs --pool dedicated-ap-southeast-pool-2 --out /secure/tmp/cl-kv-1769250000.tar.gz && aws s3 cp /secure/tmp/cl-kv-1769250000.tar.gz s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1769250000/ --acl private```Upload complete; object locked, access logged by AuditBot.
AuditBot: Audit log: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1769250000/cl-kv-1769250000.tar.gz uploaded by sree@redwood. Access policy: restricted; UUID: a7f3-9c2e.
Hana (Customer Success): CardioLabsOps, we recommend switching critical traffic to your standby pool to restore service quickly. Do we have approval to proceed?
CardioLabsOps: We authorize a manual failover for critical endpoints only. Make sure TLS and rotation policy match our security controls. Also provide timeline and estimate of failed requests.
Nora (oncall): Sree, prep routing change but don't apply until Hana confirms. Include sticky=false to avoid session pinning. Also prepare to enable hosted fallback if standby fails, but only with AE approval.
Sree (SRE): Prepared command:```infra-api route apply --tenant CardioLabs --paths "/v1/infer/*" --target dedicated-ap-southeast-standby-1 --sticky=false --note "manual failover per customer approval"```Standby model compatibility check: model v2.0.1-qat compatible, cache warm required.
Hana (Customer Success): Proceed with failover now. CardioLabsOps: confirming go-ahead.
CardioLabsOps: Go ahead. Prioritize low-latency endpoints. We'll coordinate key rotation if needed.
IncidentBot: Routing change requested by sree@redwood. Propagation ETA ~10s.
Sree (SRE): Executed routing change. Early telemetry: 5xxs drop from 17% -> 0.9% across new requests. In-flight sessions still showing some failures.
Nora (oncall): Marking customer impact: degraded for CardioLabs between 02:00Z-02:22Z with partial loss from in-flight requests. Hana, please collect customer-reported failure rate.
CardioLabsOps: Dashboards show ~5% failed for a brief window, mostly between 02:05-02:18Z. We paused non-essential batch jobs.
Leo (Account Exec): I'll draft a customer-facing note: apology, summary, timeline, mitigation, and offer provisional SLA credit. Hana, include exact failed counts and confirm no data leakage.
Sree (SRE): No outbound anomalies seen. Errors internal 502/503. Snapshot stored and access-restricted. Will attach audit trail and list of files used in RCA.
Nora (oncall): On-call handoff in 30m to EngOps. Handoff items: watch `kv_checkpoint_mismatch`, `5xx_rate` for CardioLabs, `route_state`, `standby_cache_warmup`. If shard mismatch reappears, emergency plan = enable hosted hardened fallback with AE approval.
Hana (Customer Success): Draft comms for review: "Hi CardioLabs  we observed elevated error rates impacting your service between 02:00Z and 02:22Z. We identified a KV shard metadata inconsistency in your dedicated pool and performed a manual failover to your standby pool to restore service. We do not see evidence of data exposure. We've uploaded a forensic snapshot under restricted access and will provide a full RCA and proposed mitigations. We'll also compute any applicable SLA credit." Suggestions?
CardioLabsOps: Add POC names and include expected latency delta: standby may add ~20-60ms while cache warms for ~10-12 minutes. Also confirm key rotation steps if any tokens changed.
Leo (Account Exec): Adding POC: Sree (SRE) tech, Hana (CS) ops, Leo (AE) billing. For SLA calc: CardioLabs SLA 99.95% monthly. Downtime window 22 minutes -> monthly minutes=43200 -> downtime% = 22/43200 = 0.0509%. Starting propose credit ~0.05% pro-rated. We'll finalize after RCA.
Sree (SRE): Creating RCA draft and reproduction notes. Hypothesis: concurrent eviction + compaction under heavy small-request workload triggered metadata write race -> checksum divergence. Actions: stronger metadata locking, prewarm hooks, and improved disk health alerts. Posting draft to Confluence: `https://confluence.internal/incidents/INC-2026-1769250000/rca-draft`
Hana (Customer Success): CardioLabsOps, sending the customer email now; will CC Leo and Sree. Also scheduling a follow-up exec call for tomorrow 09:00 their local.
CardioLabsOps: Received. Please include sanitized logs for our security team. We'll need to sign the access addendum to get full forensic dump.
AuditBot: Access request logged for forensic dump. Access will be granted after signed addendum; audit trail will be included.
EngOps (rotation): Taking handoff at 02:30Z. Nora, leave CLI history and dashboards: `/dash/tenants/CardioLabs/overview`, `/dash/pools/dedicated-ap-southeast-pool-2/kvm`, command history saved at `/var/log/oncall/1769250000-history.log`. Ongoing tasks: monitor `5xx_rate` < 0.5%, complete KV repair ticket INC-1769250000-KV, verify standby cache warm success.
Nora (oncall): Handoff note: checkpoint of commands and logs uploaded, KV dump path posted to incident ticket. If `kv_checkpoint_mismatch` resurfaces, escalate to infra lead.
Sree (SRE): Will include failed-request counts and exact audit logs in RCA. Also plan to run stress repro in staging to validate fix.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-1769250000 created and status set to mitigated -> monitoring. Post-incident checklist created and assigned.
Leo (Account Exec): Final thought: offer a complimentary 1-on-1 runbook session and optional paid resilience review. Will include in customer mail as goodwill gesture.
Hana (Customer Success): Sending final comms. Thanks team.
